actions.description: Attach a small file (under 3 MB) to an Outlook event.
actions.name: add-event-attachment

contentType.description: MIME type of the attachment. Example: "text/plain"

actions.description: Attach a file to a draft message. Note: 3 MB simple upload limit applies.
actions.name: add-message-attachment

messageId.description: The ID of the draft message to attach the file to. Example: "AQMkAGFk..."

fileName.description: The name of the file to attach. Example: "document.pdf"

contentType.description: The MIME type of the file. Example: "application/pdf"

contentBytes.description: The base64-encoded content of the file. Example: "JVBERi0xLjQK..."

actions.description: Cancel a meeting and send the cancellation notice to attendees
actions.name: cancel-event

eventId.description: The ID of the event to cancel. Example: "AQMkAGI2..."

comment.description: An optional comment to include in the cancellation message sent to attendees.

actions.description: Copy a message to another mail folder.
actions.name: copy-message

messageId.description: The ID of the message to copy. Example: "AQMkADAwATM0MDAAMS1iN..."

destinationId.description: The ID of the destination mail folder, or a well-known folder name such as "inbox", "drafts", "sentitems", "deleteditems".

actions.description: Create a secondary calendar in the mailbox.
actions.name: create-calendar

name.description: Name of the new calendar. Example: "Team Events"

color.description: Color theme for the calendar. Example: "lightBlue"

actions.description: Create a draft email message
actions.name: create-draft-message

subject.description: Subject of the message. Example: "Meeting notes"

toRecipients.description: List of recipients to send the message to

isReadReceiptRequested.description: Whether a read receipt was requested

isDeliveryReceiptRequested.description: Whether a delivery receipt was requested

actions.description: Create an event on a calendar.
actions.name: create-event

calendarId.description: Calendar ID. If omitted, the event is created in the default calendar. Example: "AQMkAGI2..."

dateTime.description: Start time in ISO 8601 format. Example: "2024-06-15T10:00:00"

timeZone.description: Time zone for start time. Example: "UTC" or "Pacific Standard Time"

dateTime.description: End time in ISO 8601 format. Example: "2024-06-15T11:00:00"

timeZone.description: Time zone for end time. Example: "UTC" or "Pacific Standard Time"

displayName.description: Location display name. Example: "Conference Room A"

attendees.description: List of attendees to invite to the event.

isOnlineMeeting.description: Whether to create an online meeting (Teams).

actions.description: Create a child mail folder in Outlook.
actions.name: create-mail-folder

parentFolderId.description: The unique identifier of the parent mail folder. Example: "AQMkAGI2..."

displayName.description: The display name of the new mail folder. Example: "Work"

hidden.description: Whether the folder should be hidden from standard folder lists.

actions.description: Delete a secondary calendar.
actions.name: delete-calendar

calendarId.description: The ID of the calendar to delete. Example: "AAMkAGI..."

actions.description: Delete an event from a calendar.
actions.name: delete-event

event_id.description: The ID of the event to delete. Example: "AAMkAGI2..."

calendar_id.description: Optional calendar ID. If omitted, uses the default calendar.

actions.description: Delete a message from the mailbox
actions.name: delete-message

messageId.description: The unique identifier of the message to delete. Example: "AAMkAGVmMDEzM..."

actions.description: Download the content of a file attachment on a message.
actions.name: download-message-attachment

messageId.description: The ID of the message containing the attachment. Example: "AAMkAGVmMD..."

attachmentId.description: The ID of the attachment to download. Example: "AAMkAGVmMD..."

content.description: The base64-encoded content of the attachment.

contentType.description: The MIME type of the attachment content.

name.description: The name of the attachment file.

actions.description: Retrieve a calendar by ID.
actions.name: get-calendar

calendarId.description: The unique identifier of the calendar. Example: "AAMkAGI2TGuLAAA="

actions.description: Retrieve an event by ID from the user's calendar
actions.name: get-event

eventId.description: The unique identifier of the event. Example: "AAMkAGI1AAAoZDOFAAA="

timezone.description: The time zone to use for returning event dates. Example: "Pacific Standard Time"

select.description: A comma-separated list of properties to include in the response. Example: "subject,start,end,location"

actions.description: Retrieve a message by ID.
actions.name: get-message

messageId.description: The unique identifier of the message. Example: "AAMkAGVmMD..."

expandAttachments.description: If true, expands the attachments relationship in the response.

actions.description: List events from a calendar or date window.
actions.name: list-calendar-events

calendar_id.description: The ID of the calendar to list events from. If omitted, the default calendar is used. Example: "AQMkADAwATM0..."

start_date_time.description: Start of the date range (ISO 8601 format). Required when using calendarView. Example: "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z"

end_date_time.description: End of the date range (ISO 8601 format). Required when using calendarView. Example: "2024-01-31T23:59:59Z"

top.description: Maximum number of events to return per page. Default: 10, Max: 50.

actions.description: List calendars in the mailbox.
actions.name: list-calendars

cursor.description: Full @odata.nextLink URL from the previous response for pagination. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: Maximum number of calendars to return. Default is 10, maximum is 50.

actions.description: List attachments on an event.
actions.name: list-event-attachments

eventId.description: The ID of the event to list attachments for. Example: "AAMkAGVmMDEzMTM4LTZmYWUtNDdkNC1hMDZiLTU1OGY5OTZhYmY4OABGAAAAAAAiQ8W967B7TKBjgx9rVEURBwAiIsqMbYjsT5e-T7KzowPTAAAAAAENAAAiIsqMbYjsT5e-T7KzowPTAAAa_WKzAAA="

nextLink.description: Pagination link for the next page of results. Omit for the first page.

actions.description: List child folders under a mail folder
actions.name: list-mail-folder-children

folderId.description: The ID of the mail folder to list children for. Example: "AAMkAGVmODUyMzE1LTM0MDctNDNlMS05YjQ1LTI4MjE5MjJmYzY1ZgAuAAAAAADY3h3zQIGrQ6Pm8GPMwoNdAQCr0pwLSY4vT6AX1L4UHn_uAAAAAAEJAAA="

limit.description: Maximum number of folders to return per page. Default is 10.

cursor.description: Full @odata.nextLink URL from the previous response for pagination. Omit for the first page.

next_cursor.description: Cursor to fetch the next page of results. Absent if there are no more pages.

actions.description: List top-level mail folders from the mailbox
actions.name: list-mail-folders

limit.description: Number of folders to return per page. Max 50.

nextLink.description: OData nextLink for pagination from previous response
OData nextLink for retrieving the next page

actions.description: List attachments on a message.
actions.name: list-message-attachments

messageId.description: The unique identifier of the message to list attachments for. Example: "AAMkAGVmMD..."

actions.description: List messages from a mail folder.
actions.name: list-messages

folderId.description: Mail folder ID. Use "inbox" for the inbox folder. Example: "inbox"

filter.description: OData filter expression for receivedDateTime. Example: "receivedDateTime ge 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z"

select.description: Comma-separated list of properties to include. Example: "id,subject,receivedDateTime,from"

cursor.description: Pagination link (odata.nextLink) from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to return per page. Default: 10, Max: 50.

actions.description: Move a message to another mail folder.
actions.name: move-message

messageId.description: The unique identifier of the message to move. Example: "AAMkAGVmMDEz..."

destinationId.description: The unique identifier of the destination mail folder. Example: "AAMkAGVmMDEzMjA..."

actions.description: Reply to all recipients on a message
actions.name: reply-all-to-message

messageId.description: The ID of the message to reply to

comment.description: A comment to include in the reply. Required when not creating a draft.

createDraft.description: If true, creates a draft reply instead of sending immediately

body.description: The body of the reply message. Use instead of comment for more control.

draftId.description: The ID of the created draft (only when createDraft is true)

actions.description: Reply to a message sender.
actions.name: reply-to-message

messageId.description: The ID of the message to reply to. Example: "AAMkAGVmMDEZ..."

comment.description: The plain text body of the reply message. Example: "Thank you for your email. I will get back to you soon."

actions.description: Send an existing draft message.
actions.name: send-draft-message

message_id.description: The unique identifier of the draft message to send. Example: "AAMkAGVmMDEz..."

success.description: Whether the draft was sent successfully

message_id.description: The ID of the draft that was sent. This equals the input draft ID; the send endpoint returns no body to confirm the sent item ID.

actions.description: Send a new email message immediately
actions.name: send-mail

subject.description: The subject of the message. Example: "Hello from Nango"

contentType.description: The content type of the body. Example: "html"

content.description: The content of the body. Example: "Hello world"

name.description: The display name of the recipient. Example: "John Doe"

ccRecipients.description: The CC recipients of the message

name.description: The display name of the recipient. Example: "John Doe"

bccRecipients.description: The BCC recipients of the message

name.description: The display name of the recipient. Example: "John Doe"

replyTo.description: The reply-to recipients of the message

name.description: The display name of the recipient. Example: "John Doe"

importance.description: The importance of the message. Example: "normal"

saveToSentItems.description: Whether to save the message in Sent Items. Default: true

actions.description: Update calendar properties.
actions.name: update-calendar

calendarId.description: The unique identifier of the calendar to update. Example: "AQMkAGI..."

color.description: The color of the calendar in hex format or a preset color constant. Example: "#2B579A" or "lightBlue"

actions.description: Update event details in Outlook calendar.
actions.name: update-event

eventId.description: The unique identifier of the event to update. Example: "AAMkAGI1..."

start.description: The start time of the event.

dateTime.description: The start date and time in ISO 8601 format.

end.description: The end time of the event.

dateTime.description: The end date and time in ISO 8601 format.

actions.description: Update a draft or mutable message fields.
actions.name: update-message

messageId.description: The unique identifier of the message to update. Example: "AAMkAGVmMDEz"

contentType.description: The content type of the body.

categories.description: The categories associated with the message.

isRead.description: Indicates whether the message has been read.

flag.description: The flag status of the message.

flagStatus.description: The flag status of the message.
